glosses: inheritance; heritage; legacy; bequest (property that is bequeathed and inherited)
heritage (anything that is passed down from preceding generations, e.g. genes, values, attitudes, traditions, etc.)

examples.text: Er hat das Erbe seines Onkels angetreten.
examples.en: He succeeded to his uncle's fortune.

examples.text: Wir müssen mehr tun, um unser kulturelles Erbe zu schützen.
examples.en: We must do more to protect our cultural heritage.

examples.text: Tom erfuhr erst nach dem Tode seiner Mutter, dass diese sein Erbe verspielt hatte.
examples.en: Tom only found out after his mother's death that she had gambled away his inheritance.
